title_zh: 确定使馆代表团的到场接待联系人

scenario.label_zh: 确定使馆代表团到访的接待联系人
scenario.goal_zh: 核对代表团人数及发言代表，并约定在正门接待

context_zh: 文化中心工作人员与虚构使馆的活动联络员电话沟通到访安排。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: I am calling from the embassy about tomorrow's visit to your cultural centre.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Welcome. How many people are in the delegation?

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Three. One delegate, Ms Varga, will speak on behalf of the group.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Is she the diplomat who wrote to us about the exhibition?

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Yes. She would appreciate meeting the host before the tour begins.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I can greet all three of you at the main entrance at ten and introduce her to the host.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: That works. I will be the contact if we are delayed.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Good. I have your number, and I will put my name, Felix, on the reception note.
